quest.51301100AAEE96B5.quest_desc: The Compressor turns metal ingots into plates through compressing recipes and consumes FE. Its SOQM crafting recipe requires an Industrial Chassis, two Pistons and six Iron Ingots.
Connect power, insert an ingot and leave the output slot clear. You will use this machine again after reaching the Moon: one Desh Ingot produces one Desh Plate for space components and Stellar Alloy.
quest.51301100AAEE96B5.title: Obtain 1 × Compressor
quest.51301101FA8B13AD.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Steel Ingot (ad_astra:steel_ingot). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301101FA8B13AD.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Ingot
quest.51301102879BA857.quest_desc: Fill a Gas Tank with oxygen in an Oxygen Loader and inspect its contents before launch. An empty tank occupies the same inventory slot but provides no reserve for your suit.
Use the filled tank to distribute its contents into compatible items in your inventory. Keep the reserve accessible during the expedition and monitor the suit’s actual oxygen supply.
quest.51301102879BA857.title: Obtain 1 × Gas Tank
quest.513011028FE78243.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Desh Cable (ad_astra:desh_cable). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011028FE78243.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.513011028FE78243.title: Obtain 4 × Desh Cable
quest.51301102AE9BB373.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Desh Tank (ad_astra:desh_tank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301102AE9BB373.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.51301102AE9BB373.title: Obtain 1 × Desh Tank

quest.5130110A4743ECB0.title: Obtain 1 × Fan

Have in your inventory 1 × Jet Suit Pants (ad_astra:jet_suit_pants). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Jet Suit Boots (ad_astra:jet_suit_boots). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111066461318.title: Obtain 1 × Jet Suit Helmet + Obtain 1 × Jet Suit Pants + More
quest.5130111A30152678.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Ostrum Plate (ad_astra:ostrum_plate). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111A30152678.title: Obtain 1 × Ostrum Plate
quest.5130111C890D830A.quest_desc: Assemble the Tier 4 Rocket in the NASA Workbench from six Calorite Blocks, two Calorite Tanks, four Rocket Fins, a Calorite Engine and a Rocket Nose Cone. The earlier engine chain is included in the cost of its new engine.
This tier opens travel to a new solar system. The Interstellar quest requires entering Glacio; merely obtaining the rocket is covered by its separate item task.
quest.5130111C890D830A.title: Obtain 1 × Tier 4 Rocket
quest.5130111D0840212E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Netherite Space Helmet (ad_astra:netherite_space_helmet). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Netherite Space Pants (ad_astra:netherite_space_pants). The items are not consumed by this task.
Have in your inventory 1 × Netherite Space Boots (ad_astra:netherite_space_boots). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111D0840212E.title: Obtain 1 × Netherite Space Helmet + Obtain 1 × Netherite Space Pants + More
quest.5130112238B982DA.quest_desc: The SOQM Desh Engine consumes a Steel Engine and adds Desh Plates, a Fan, Stellar Alloy, a Quantum Processor and a Dimensional Matrix. Lunar ore unlocks its metal, while assembly also relies on your cross-mod production line.
After the engine, prepare the remaining Tier 2 Rocket components for the NASA Workbench. The engine alone is not a complete rocket and does not carry over fuel from a previous craft.
quest.5130112238B982DA.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.5130112238B982DA.title: Obtain 1 × Desh Engine
quest.51301123D24102F2.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Wrench (ad_astra:wrench). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301123D24102F2.title: Obtain 1 × Wrench
quest.51301125F300B5D5.quest_desc: The NASA Workbench performs the final assembly of rockets. Prepare the nose cone, body blocks, tanks, fins and engine for the desired tier separately; a normal 3×3 crafting grid cannot assemble these recipes.

The station’s SOQM recipe requires a Dimensional Matrix, a Control Assembly and a Precision Mechanism alongside steel and other components. An assembled rocket still needs a Launch Pad and fuel before launch.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Control Assembly.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture NASA Workbench. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.51301125F300B5D5.title: Obtain 1 × Nasa Workbench
quest.5130112935FFF4C2.quest_desc: In this Ad Astra version, Interstellar requires actually entering Glacio. Prepare a Tier 4 Rocket, fuel, oxygen and a return kit, then select the planet in the new system.
Orbiting a planet or merely crafting the Tier 4 Rocket does not meet this condition. After landing, retain the landing equipment and check supplies before exploring farther.
quest.5130112935FFF4C2.title: Interstellar
quest.5130112D843FED07.quest_desc: Power the Oxygen Loader, supply water to its water tank and wait for oxygen to accumulate. The machine converts water into oxygen.
Use its container slot to fill the Space Suit and spare Gas Tanks. Inspect the oxygen amount on the finished equipment before disconnecting and launching.
This is ground preparation for the first Moon trip. An Oxygen Distributor creates a habitable area at a base and serves a different purpose.
quest.5130112D843FED07.title: Oxygen Loader: Fill before Flight
quest.51301138CDC4FC6E.quest_desc: Travel to Mars requires at least a tier-two rocket. The next resource target is Ostrum, used for the Netherite Space Suit, more advanced machines and the tier-three rocket.
The task checks actually entering the Mars dimension. Assembling a rocket or viewing the planet in the travel menu does not complete it; keep your return equipment and fuel after landing.
quest.51301138CDC4FC6E.title: The Martian
quest.5130113E390D02AA.quest_desc: On the Moon, watch your oxygen and keep the return kit intact. Ordinary torches and water behave differently from Earth; use suitable lighting.
Mine Desh underground. Return with enough for processing and plates, which contribute to Stellar Alloy and radiation shielding.
For the return flight, recover equipment from the lander, place the Launch Pad and rocket and refuel it. A lunar base with an Oxygen Distributor is a separate next project.
quest.5130113E390D02AA.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.5130113E390D02AA.title: First Landing: Desh and a Return Route
quest.51301144D2BF0879.quest_desc: The SOQM Calorite Engine consumes an Ostrum Engine, four Calorite Plates, a Fan, a Quantum Processor, a Mythic Circuit and a Radiation Shield. Finishing this component requires the mythic and radiation-related production lines.
Reserve the engine for the Tier 4 Rocket and prepare additional Calorite for its body and tanks. Keep enough metal for the rocket’s body blocks instead of turning the whole stock into plates.
quest.51301144D2BF0879.title: Obtain 1 × Calorite Engine
quest.51301148648A5155.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Etrium Ingot (ad_astra:etrium_ingot). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301148648A5155.title: Obtain 1 × Etrium Ingot
quest.5130114FE09DA6CE.quest_desc: Prepare the Space Helmet, Space Pants and Space Boots before the first landing. Equip them together with the oxygen-filled Space Suit chest piece.
Check all four armor slots before departure. Strong armor from another mod does not automatically provide Ad Astra’s environmental protection.
quest.5130114FE09DA6CE.title: Complete Space Equipment
quest.51301152E78DE39E.quest_desc: The Ostrum Engine consumes a Desh Engine. It also requires Ostrum Plates, a Fan, Stellar Alloy, a Quantum Processor and a Dimensional Matrix, so the new ore does not replace the earlier engine stage.
Budget Ostrum separately for the engine, tanks and six body blocks of the Tier 3 Rocket. Also reserve enough for a complete protective space suit before visiting hot planets.
quest.51301152E78DE39E.title: Obtain 1 × Ostrum Engine
quest.51301154264E3947.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Steel Plate (ad_astra:steel_plate). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301154264E3947.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Plate
quest.5130115956283BA9.quest_desc: Craft the Space Suit and fill it with oxygen in an Oxygen Loader. Equip the complete ordinary space set: the chest piece supplies oxygen but does not replace the other equipment.
Check actual oxygen reserves and carry filled Gas Tanks. This set protects in cold airless environments; hot planets need the next protection tier.
The item task accepts the suit regardless of its fill level. Check oxygen before launch yourself: the completion mark does not measure the reserve.
quest.5130115956283BA9.title: Fill the Suit before the First Moon Trip
quest.51301162F20C9431.quest_desc: Hold the Zip Gun and use it to propel yourself. The native condition checks using the item, not merely owning it.
Test in an open safe area first. It assists movement in zero gravity; watch your direction and keep a way back to stable ground.
quest.51301162F20C9431.title: Zip Gun: A Controlled Boost
quest.513011635A57E77B.quest_desc: The Oxygen Distributor converts water into oxygen for a sealed room and needs continuous FE. Supply water to its tank; for ongoing water supply, place a Water Pump over an infinite water source next to the distributor and power both machines.
Seal the room and press Show in the distributor GUI: the highlighted volume shows where oxygen actually reaches. Resolve leak warnings; internal doors and walls may require Vents between rooms.
Check the occupied area before removing your suit. The quest detects the Oxygen Distributor item; placement, water supply, power and a sealed enclosure must be arranged separately.
quest.513011635A57E77B.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.513011635A57E77B.title: Obtain 1 × Oxygen Distributor
quest.5130116AA9FFE833.quest_desc: The Solar Panel generates FE, with output depending on the world, distance from the star and atmosphere. Read its actual generation in the GUI after placement instead of assuming the output of another planet.

Its SOQM recipe requires Desh Plates, Photovoltaic Etrium Cells, Steel Plates, a Control Assembly and a Precision Mechanism. For base life support, compare generation with the Oxygen Distributor and water pump demand and provide energy storage.
quest.5130116AA9FFE833.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.5130116AA9FFE833.title: Obtain 1 × Solar Panel
quest.5130116E4E3E32D1.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Earth Globe (ad_astra:earth_globe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130116E4E3E32D1.title: Obtain 1 × Earth Globe
quest.513011797B8A9790.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Unconventional Flight (ad_astra:zip_gun). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011797B8A9790.title: Obtain 1 × Unconventional Flight
quest.51301179BA55079F.quest_desc: Assemble the Tier 2 Rocket in the NASA Workbench using six Desh Blocks, two Desh Tanks, four Rocket Fins, a Desh Engine and a Rocket Nose Cone. The six body blocks require metal in addition to the plates used by the engine and tanks.
The tier-two rocket enables travel to Mars. Transfer your equipment, oxygen and return kit before launch, then check the new rocket’s own fuel supply.
quest.51301179BA55079F.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.51301179BA55079F.title: Obtain 1 × Tier 2 Rocket
quest.5130117C137CE470.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Radio (ad_astra:radio). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130117C137CE470.title: Obtain 1 × Radio
quest.5130117C7AD68848.quest_desc: Calorite is the next target after unlocking the hot planets Venus and Mercury. Prepare heat protection and oxygen, collect Raw Calorite and smelt it into ingots.

The Tier 4 Rocket requires six Calorite Blocks plus the materials for its tanks and engine. The SOQM engine recipe also depends on a Mythic Circuit and Radiation Shield, so the new metal is only part of interstellar preparation.
quest.5130117C7AD68848.title: Obtain 1 × Calorite Ingot
quest.5130118F5614ED98.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × TI-69 (ad_astra:ti_69). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130118F5614ED98.title: Obtain 1 × TI-69
quest.513011956693E047.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Calorite Plate (ad_astra:calorite_plate). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011956693E047.title: Obtain 1 × Calorite Plate
quest.513011984F5B40C8.quest_desc: Fill an oxygen bucket from the Oxygen Loader after it processes water. This checks ground-based oxygen production before the first flight.
For a longer trip, fill the suit and Gas Tanks and inspect their capacities. Owning one bucket does not prove you have enough oxygen for the expedition.
quest.513011984F5B40C8.title: Oxygen as an Expedition Supply
quest.5130119A494692FD.quest_desc: In SOQM, the Steel Engine needs a Dimensional Matrix, five Steel Plates, an Engine Frame and a Fan. The matrix ties the first rocket engine to the earlier magic and dimensional progression.
The finished engine is a rocket component, not a supply of rocket fuel. The next Desh Engine also consumes a Steel Engine as an ingredient, so account for that in your production plan.
quest.5130119A494692FD.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Engine
quest.513011A99D6EA3A8.quest_desc: Process oil into Fuel in a powered Fuel Refinery. The rocket uses refined fuel; a bucket of crude oil is not a substitute.
Shift-right-click the placed rocket and fill its tank according to the gauge. Pack fuel for a return launch and a launch pad separately in its cargo.
Prepare the return trip on Earth. The quest checks an item, not all of the rocket’s supplies.
quest.513011A99D6EA3A8.title: Fuel for Departure and Return
quest.513011AA7F850AD0.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Calorite Tank (ad_astra:calorite_tank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011AA7F850AD0.title: Obtain 1 × Calorite Tank
quest.513011ABD424EA8F.quest_desc: Craft the rocket in a NASA Workbench, build a Launch Pad and place the rocket in its center. Shift-right-click opens its fuel and cargo inventory.
Before launching, prepare a full oxygen-filled space set, spare oxygen, food, tools, airless-safe lighting and the fuel and launch pad for your return.
Enter the fueled rocket and press the jump key. After landing, recover the rocket and cargo from the lander instead of leaving your return equipment inside.
quest.513011ABD424EA8F.title: Tier 1 Rocket: Prepare to Launch
quest.513011AC257CA77E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Ostrum Tank (ad_astra:ostrum_tank). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011AC257CA77E.title: Obtain 1 × Ostrum Tank
quest.513011AC5E9A34D4.quest_desc: Configure Desh Fluid Pipe endpoints with the Ad Astra wrench. Extract at the source pumps fluid into the network, while Insert at the receiving machine delivers it; simply connecting pipes does not establish an extraction endpoint.
Use the corresponding Fluid Pipe Duct when passing through the wall of a sealed base. After installation, check both the receiving tank and the room’s seal using the Oxygen Distributor.
quest.513011AC5E9A34D4.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.513011AC5E9A34D4.title: Obtain 4 × Desh Fluid Pipe
quest.513011B6548D0312.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Engine Frame (ad_astra:engine_frame). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011B6548D0312.title: Obtain 1 × Engine Frame
quest.513011B86476F5E1.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement Venusian (ad_astra:venus). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011B86476F5E1.title: Venusian
quest.513011BEB9C533E8.quest_desc: The Oxygen Sensor emits a redstone signal when it detects oxygen at its location. Use it to indicate the state of a room served by an Oxygen Distributor; the sensor itself does not produce breathable air.
Interacting while sneaking inverts the signal. Check which state means an alarm in your circuit, and place the sensor in the occupied area rather than checking only beside the machine.
quest.513011BEB9C533E8.title: Obtain 1 × Oxygen Sensor
quest.513011C599FF7F42.quest_desc: The Netherite Space Suit is the chest piece of the set used on hot planets. Also prepare the Netherite Space Helmet, Pants and Boots before visiting Venus or Mercury; equip the complete protective set.
The upgrade provides heat protection but does not remove the need for oxygen. Fill the suit in an Oxygen Loader and check your spare Gas Tanks before departure.
quest.513011C599FF7F42.title: Obtain 1 × Netherite Space Suit
quest.513011CAEFCC265B.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Steel Rod (ad_astra:steel_rod). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011CAEFCC265B.title: Obtain 1 × Steel Rod
quest.513011CDEACD7F3A.quest_desc: Earn the native advancement Quite the Sun Tan (ad_astra:mercury). Follow its requirement in the Advancements screen or the mod's guide.
quest.513011CDEACD7F3A.title: Quite the Sun Tan
quest.513011CEB2DA43F7.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Iron Plate (ad_astra:iron_plate). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011CEB2DA43F7.title: Obtain 1 × Iron Plate
quest.513011D056923FAA.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Oxygen Gear (ad_astra:oxygen_gear). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D056923FAA.title: Obtain 1 × Oxygen Gear
quest.513011D1CD69347F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Jet Suit (ad_astra:jet_suit). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D1CD69347F.title: Obtain 1 × Jet Suit
quest.513011D45DD1A1E7.quest_desc: In a powered Compressor, one Desh Ingot becomes one Desh Plate; compressing a full Desh Block produces nine plates. Smelt lunar raw material into ingots first, then start plate production.
Reserve four plates for a batch of four Stellar Alloys. Engines, base equipment and Radiation Shields also need plates, so distribute your lunar stock across those planned components.
quest.513011D45DD1A1E7.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.513011D45DD1A1E7.title: Obtain 1 × Desh Plate
quest.513011F70694CD2B.quest_desc: Combine six Ostrum Blocks, two Ostrum Tanks, four Rocket Fins, an Ostrum Engine and a Rocket Nose Cone in the NASA Workbench. These components assemble the complete Tier 3 Rocket.

Tier three enables travel to Venus and Mercury. Prepare a full oxygen-filled Netherite Space Suit before selecting those destinations; reaching a planet does not make a standard suit suitable for its heat.
quest.513011F70694CD2B.title: Obtain 1 × Tier 3 Rocket
quest.513011FBDEB88C4F.quest_desc: Look for Ostrum on Mars. Smelt Raw Ostrum in a furnace or blast furnace, then send some of the resulting ingots to the Compressor for plates.
Budget for two routes at once: the Tier 3 Rocket and the Netherite Space Suit needed on hot planets. Reserve the suit materials before committing your stock to the rocket’s six body blocks.
quest.513011FBDEB88C4F.title: Obtain 1 × Ostrum Ingot
quest.513011FE61D9DE0F.quest_desc: Desh is the first metal in lunar progression. Mine Raw Desh on the Moon and smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace to obtain Desh Ingots.
Divide your stock between body blocks for the Tier 2 Rocket and ingots for the Compressor. Desh Plates also feed Stellar Alloy, connecting your lunar expedition to the wider SOQM campaign.
quest.513011FE61D9DE0F.quest_subtitle: The Moon, Desh and an oxygenated base
quest.513011FE61D9DE0F.title: Obtain 1 × Desh Ingot
quest.513011FF85542D3F.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Moon Globe (ad_astra:moon_globe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011FF85542D3F.title: Obtain 1 × Moon Globe

quest.51401116CDEA7FC4.title: Obtain 1 × Mars Tin Ore

Have in your inventory 1 × Venus Uranium Ore (mekanismaaa:venus_uranium_ore). The items are not consumed by this task.
